growth_signal.value: Launched a new suite of AI agents (called Real-time Agent Intelligence Network) in September 2026 that automate routine finance work, expanding beyond its original card and expense product.

entry.idea: African businesses waste time on manual bookkeeping, chasing unpaid invoices, and tracking spending, so Bujeti gives them corporate cards, expense management, and now AI agents that do this finance work automatically.
entry.lesson: Once you own a company's core workflow data, like their spending, you can layer AI agents on top to automate the manual work around it and deepen the product.
entry.name: Bujeti

growth.basis: substitute: new product launch (AI agent suite) years after its seed funding
growth.reason: No user or revenue numbers are public, but launching a full new AI product line years after its seed round is a sign of continued development.

market.reason: Business expense management and finance automation is a real, growing need across African businesses, but it is one region rather than a global market.

tech.reason: Building AI agents on top of an existing expense and card platform is solid engineering, but a well-funded competitor could build something similar in months.

entry.who_pays: African businesses that pay a fee to use Bujeti's corporate cards and expense and finance management platform.
entry.why_now: African businesses are moving past just trying out AI and are starting to put it directly into daily operations like finance and bookkeeping.
